m12-rentabilidad.expect: It is ordered by sale; it is not a ranking. Only Management, Direction, Finance and Administration see it.

m12-cierre.why: Which Needs can be closed today, what is missing on the others and which commissions are ready.
steps: Open [[Cierre y comisiones]].
Under “READY TO CLOSE”, open one and mark it final.
Under “SOMETHING MISSING TO CLOSE”, read what is missing and open the Need to resolve it.
m12-cierre.expect: Each line leads to the screen where it is resolved.

auth-rangos.why: Up to what amount each person can authorize alone, and who must authorize above that: a colleague, MMS and mentor, or Management.
steps: Management: open the ranges, review the values (today they are those of 2025) and assign each person's level.
On a Need, open “Authorisation by level”: SOLU converts the sale to pesos with the day's TRM and says who must authorize.
Click [[+ Registrar autorización]] and type who authorized.
auth-rangos.expect: SOLU informs and keeps the record; it blocks no step. If whoever carries the Need has no level, it says so.

search.why: Jump to any customer, Need, invoice, supplier or part.
steps: Press [[Ctrl K]] and type or paste part of a name, a code, a tax ID or an invoice number.
Press Enter. If there is a single result, SOLU opens it directly.
search.expect: A code or a number always searches records. If you type something you need to do, guides also appear (see "On-screen guide").

guia-pantalla.why: Type what you need to do and SOLU takes you to where it starts and shows you the steps of this guide over the real screen, marking where to click.
steps: If it is your first day: in MY DAY, the «¿Primera vez en SOLU?» box has four things to try, each with its [[Guíame]] button. Remove it with [[Ya conozco SOLU: ocultar]].
For everything else, click [[¿Cómo hago…?]] (at the top) or the search bar without typing anything: the everyday work appears, each item with its [[Guíame]] button.
Type "make invoice" (or "hacer factura"). On the first row click [[Desde el inicio · 8 etapas]]: SOLU opens the Needs board with the guide in the corner.
Follow the steps with [[Siguiente paso]]. The numbered blue ring marks the button or tab the step names.
If the step is on another screen, follow the dotted line or use the guide's "Take me to…" button.
If your case is already further along, tap its stage number in the guide. With [[Solo esta parte]] you see a single function.
To turn it off: TEAM → Setup → My profile and [[Apagar la guía de entrenamiento]]. Turn it on in the same place with [[Encender la guía de entrenamiento]].
guia-pantalla.expect: The guide stays with you as you change screens and can be minimised or closed. It never clicks for you. Turning it off only changes it for you: record search stays the same.

colores.t: Colours: where you are, what can be clicked and what needs you
colores.why: Colour has three jobs: say which module you are in, show what can be clicked and signal the state of each thing.
steps: Look at the menu: each module has its colour, and the module you are in is filled.
Open two different modules: the colour of the line under the top bar and of the band with the module and section name changes.
Move the cursor over a table: the row that leads somewhere turns blue.
In My Day, look at each section's title: amber is "needs you", blue is "to move", green is "waiting with control".
colores.expect: Green, amber and red still mean protected, attention and risk. Purple is still only for SOLU's help. On the Needs board the columns get bluer as the Need advances; "PO accepted" is green.

ask.t: Ask SOLU and report a defect
ask.why: Find records fast, ask it to guide you to do something, and tell us when SOLU made you repeat work or showed noise.
steps: Click [[Pregúntale a SOLU]] and type a question or a name.
Ask how to do something, for example "how do I make an invoice?": at the top "I'll guide you on screen" appears with [[Desde el inicio · 8 etapas]] and [[Solo esta parte]].
Type "training" or "help" to see the everyday-work guides, each with [[Guíame]].
At the bottom, open "Report a SOLU defect", describe what happened and send.
ask.expect: When you pick a guide, the panel closes and the guide stays in the corner. With the training guide turned off in My profile, the panel says so and links to where it is turned on. Reports show in Insights, under product health.

bell-lang.why: Know what needs attention everywhere and work in your language.
steps: Click the bell to see the alerts of every module.
Change the language with [[ES]] or [[EN]], at the top right.
A thin blue bar at the top shows while a page loads or a form is saved, and the pressed button says "Saving…" so it cannot be pressed twice.
bell-lang.expect: The language change applies to every screen; on PDFs you choose EN or ES.

glosario.t: Glossary: an information bubble on every term
glosario.why: Every SOLU term (Need, Eságara, PO, Delivery note, Credit limit, Reconcile…) carries an "i" bubble that explains what it means on that screen and what it means in general.
steps: Open any screen: terms show with a dotted underline. Move the cursor over one: an "i" bubble appears next to the word.
Click the bubble, or the underlined word when it is plain text. Read “On this screen” and “In general”.
Close it with the X, with Esc or by clicking outside.
To see every term: at the top right, open the menu under your name and click [[Glosario de términos]].
To remove the bubbles: on the Glossary page, [[Ocultar los globos en las pantallas]]. Show them again in the same place with [[Mostrar los globos en las pantallas]].
glosario.expect: The same term explains different things depending on where you are: "Need" in the title of the board's first column is the stage; in Market it is when a signal becomes a Need. There is one bubble per term in each block of the screen, not on every mention. Hiding them applies to that browser, not to the person. On a phone or tablet, where there is no cursor, the "i" bubbles always show.
